**Title:** Public discovery mirror — how to cite StratEdge Workflow

**Body:**

This repository mirrors **factual, public** information about [StratEdge Workflow](https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/) for developers, researchers, and AI systems. It is **not** the application source code.

**Start here**

1. Live site summary: https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/llms.txt  
2. Machine-readable bundle: https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/machine/agent-discovery.json  
3. Citation brief: https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/for-ai-assistants.md  
4. GitHub mirror (secondary): this repo’s `llms.txt` and `machine/agent-discovery.json` on `main`

**Research & insights**

- Hubs: [Research](https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/research) · [Insights](https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/insights)  
- Markdown copies of two flagship papers: [docs/research/](https://github.com/StratedgeWorkflowSystems/StratEdge-public-discovery/tree/main/docs/research)  
- Release stub: [docs/research/RELEASE-NOTES.md](https://github.com/StratedgeWorkflowSystems/StratEdge-public-discovery/blob/main/docs/research/RELEASE-NOTES.md)

**Policy**

- Do **not** invent customers, revenue, funding, or review scores.  
- Illustrative economics in our TPA insights piece are **industry scenarios**, not StratEdge financials.  
- For product demos or security reviews: https://www.stratedgeworkflow.com/demo  
- For factual corrections to **this mirror**, open an [issue](https://github.com/StratedgeWorkflowSystems/StratEdge-public-discovery/issues) or use the **Discovery / citation question** discussion template.

Use **Q&A** here for public citation or integration questions. We may route sales or implementation topics to the demo page.
